342:t_013:3.en:
$$桂$$
「Our true enemy... the fundamental calamity of humanity...!」

342:t_014:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「There are more of them than before...!」

342:t_014:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Damn...! How the hell are we supposed to fight something like that!」

342:t_014:2.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「So this... is as far as we go...」

342:t_014:3.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「N-no...! I... I don't want to die yet!」

342:t_014:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(Is it over...!? Is this where we end...!)

342:t_014:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So what!? I can still fight!」

342:t_014:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm doing this...! My heart isn't broken yet!」

342:t_016:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What...!? Something is overflowing from my $$スフィア$$...!」

342:t_016:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Wait! I figure you're the one who sent us here!」

342:t_016:5.en:
???
「$$ズリエル・ジ・アンブレイカブル$$... Your unbreakable will opens the way...」

342:t_016:6.en:
???
「Someday, you will understand everything... And then, walking the path of $$シンカ$$, all the universes...」

342:t_019:0.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「...This is the $$インサラウム$$ unit of the Mars settler corps. State your affiliation.」

342:t_019:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$インサラウム$$...! Then I was right, this really is... the Mars of our world!」

342:t_019:2.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Could you be... Sir $$クロウ・ブルースト$$?」

342:t_019:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm not the kind of man who deserves a 'Sir,' but I am indeed $$クロウ・ブルースト$$.」

342:t_019:5.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We detected a $$時空震動|lc$$ and came this way, but what on earth happened?」

342:t_019:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Even if you ask, we can't explain it ourselves, either...」

342:t_019:7.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「You seem to have taken considerable damage. First, allow us to guide you to our living area.」

342:t_019:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「《$$インサラウム$$》's 《$$アークセイバー$$》...」

342:t_019:10.en:
$$カレン$$
「I don't really get it, but... looks like we get to go back to Earth...」

342:t_019:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Who knows... With incidents hitting us back to back like this, I've got a feeling there's one more upheaval waiting for us...」

342:t_020:1.en:
$n
「Hold on, AG! If the ship goes down, we're finished!」

342:t_100:0.en:
$$宗介$$
(This helplessness... It's the same as that day, when $$千鳥$$ was taken and I lost $$アル$$...)

342:t_100:1.en:
$$宗介$$
(But that's exactly why I fight...! If I admit defeat here, I'll never be able to fight again!)

342:t_101:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
(Damn... what the hell is this...! No matter how many times I shake it off, memories of that day keep crawling up from the bottom of my mind...!)

342:t_101:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
(The future of one kid that I took away... Despair and helplessness make me want to scream and cry...!)

342:t_102:0.en:
$$マオ$$
(There were plenty of times on the battlefield I almost despaired... But this is different from any of those...)

342:t_102:1.en:
$$マオ$$
(What the hell is this...? Just trying to fight those things makes me regret even being alive...!)

342:t_103:0.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
(My heart is being eaten away...)

342:t_103:1.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
(Damn...! It's as if everything in combat technique I've honed... my very existence... is being denied!)

342:t_104:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(This helplessness and fear of overwhelming power... It's the same as that day... the day $$シャルル・ジ・ブリタニア$$ took my memories away!)

342:t_104:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(That's why I'll overcome it...! For myself, and for humanity... so we can move forward!)

342:t_106:0.en:
$$カレン$$
(I've overcome despair again and again until now...! This time too...!)

342:t_106:1.en:
$$カレン$$
(Don't you dare lose...! Don't let fear crush you!)

342:t_107:0.en:
$$スザク$$
(Taking Father's life... Failing to save $$ユフィ$$... Selling out $$ルルーシュ$$...)

342:t_107:1.en:
$$スザク$$
(The regret keeps surging in... What is that enemy trying to make me do...?)

342:t_107:2.en:
$$スザク$$
(But $$ルルーシュ$$ and I decided...! To do what must be done, rather than regret...! So...!)

342:t_108:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
(A power beyond human understanding... Fighting them is like taking on the mystery of $$パラダイムシティ$$.)

342:t_108:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
(But the big difference is that they're enemies blocking our way...! Then I will face them as $$ロジャー・スミス$$!)

342:t_109:0.en:
$$キリコ$$
(A force that can't be resisted... God... fate...)

342:t_109:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
(...No matter what it is, I won't obey it...)

342:t_110:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(Overwhelming power... the existence of a god...)

342:t_110:1.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(But I turned my back on it, and I'm here...! Chasing after $$キリコ$$!)

342:t_111:0.en:
$$シャッコ$$
(The shadow of the gifted I've been chasing... I sense the same scent from them...!)

342:t_111:1.en:
$$シャッコ$$
(Heroes of $$クエント$$...! Lend me the strength to challenge a god!)

342:t_112:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(No matter the situation, as long as you're there, never giving up on the road to peace, I can fight...)

342:t_112:2.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(Even if my opponent is a god...!)

342:t_113:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
(Tch...! A self-proclaimed God of Death getting scared won't cut it!)

342:t_113:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
(Even if it's bluster, I'll do it...! That's how I've lived until now, and how I'll keep living!)

342:t_114:0.en:
$$トロワ$$
(Fear... despair... Emotions I left behind somewhere keep welling up without end...)

342:t_114:1.en:
$$トロワ$$
(...But there's nothing to do but go on... If I stop, I'm just waiting to be swallowed by it.)

342:t_115:0.en:
$$カトル$$
(A great will beyond human understanding... Is this... the Heart of Space...?)

342:t_115:1.en:
$$カトル$$
(And it's breaking my heart... The fact that I destroyed a colony, shot $$トロワ$$, piloted a $$ガンダム$$...)

342:t_115:2.en:
$$カトル$$
(...No...! This isn't the Heart of Space...!)

342:t_115:3.en:
$$カトル$$
(Everyone's will... the will to believe in the future and press on...! I know someone who embodies the Heart of Space!)

342:t_116:0.en:
$$五飛$$
(Lost, bewildered, losing my way... The impatience and frustration of that time wrap around me...)

342:t_116:1.en:
$$五飛$$
(But I know...! That unless I struggle, I can't break through to the other side...!)
